breakfast.name: Irish Full Breakfast
breakfast.description: Traditional Irish breakfast with bacon, sausages, eggs, beans, and toast
instructions: Heat baked beans in small pan
breakfast.notes: Timing is crucial to serve hot
breakfast.fun_fact: The Irish Full Breakfast (or 'fry') is a national institution and beloved Sunday breakfast

lunch.name: Colcannon (Potato and Cabbage)
lunch.description: Creamy mashed potatoes with cabbage and scallions
instructions: Mix in cabbage, scallions, milk mixture
Serve in mound with butter melting in center
lunch.notes: Must have lump in center of butter
lunch.fun_fact: Colcannon is a traditional Irish dish served especially around Halloween

dinner.name: Irish Stew
dinner.description: Hearty lamb stew with potatoes, onions, and carrots
instructions: Layer potatoes, carrots, onions in pot
Lamb and vegetables should be tender
dinner.notes: Low and slow cooking is key
dinner.fun_fact: Irish Stew is the national dish of Ireland with a history going back centuries

dinner.name: Irish Stew (Lamb and Potato Stew)
dinner.description: Traditional Irish lamb and potato stew - comfort in a pot
ingredients: 800g lamb shoulder or lamb stew meat, cubed
instructions: Heat butter in large heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Brown lamb pieces in batches, about 3-4 minutes per side; remove and set aside
Add onions to pot, cook until slightly softened (3 minutes)
Add stock, bay leaves, thyme, parsley
Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low
Continue simmering covered for 45-60 minutes until lamb is tender and potatoes are cooked through
Some potatoes will break down and thicken the stew naturally
Taste and adjust salt and pepper
Remove bay leaves and herb sprigs before serving
Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread
dinner.notes: The stew is thickened by breakdown of potatoes, not flour. Simpler is better with this dish
dinner.fun_fact: Irish Stew is mentioned in Irish literature back to the 17th century as peasant food

snacks.name: Dublin Coddle
snacks.description: Layered Dublin stew of sausages, bacon, potatoes, and onions
instructions: Potatoes and onions should be tender
snacks.fun_fact: Coddle is Dublin's iconic dish, traditionally eaten late at night after pub hopping

desserts.name: Guinness Cake
desserts.description: Dark Irish stout cake with cream cheese frosting
instructions: Reduce Guinness by half in saucepan
Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda
Whisk eggs, oil, sour cream, reduced Guinness
desserts.fun_fact: Guinness Cake is a modern Irish dessert celebrating the iconic stout
alternatives: Chocolate ganache instead of cream cheese

nonAlcoholicDrinks.name: Irish Tea
nonAlcoholicDrinks.description: Strong tea with milk and sugar
instructions: Add milk and sugar to taste
nonAlcoholicDrinks.notes: Irish tea is strong and always served with milk
nonAlcoholicDrinks.fun_fact: Tea is central to Irish culture and is consumed throughout the day

alcoholicDrinks.name: Guinness
alcoholicDrinks.description: Irish dry stout with creamy head
instructions: Pour into pint glass at 45-degree angle
Wait for settle and cascade to finish
alcoholicDrinks.fun_fact: Guinness is the world's best-selling stout and is central to Irish culture
